description.zh: 一支替你持续维护开源软件的 AI 团队：有人盯 GitHub Issue 和构建报错、有人写代码、有人在真实桌面上做打包与界面测试、有人每天定时发版。内含实战项目 OpenCompare。
description.en: An AI team that maintains open-source software end to end: watching GitHub issues & CI, writing code, testing real desktop builds, and cutting daily releases. Includes OpenCompare as a live project.

zh: daily-patrol：每晚 21:00 盘点全团队进度，把踩坑经验写回共享规则
computer：需要使用真实电脑桌面点击操作时的公共执行通道
en: daily-patrol: 21:00 nightly progress review & shared lessons update
computer: Shared operator channel for real desktop GUI actions

tasks.title: 桌面系统图形界面操作
晚间进度盘点与经验总结

summary.zh: 配备 7 项日常值班任务：GitHub Issue 与构建报错盯盘、每日 07:00 定时发版、安装包启动自检、大文件夹性能测试、软件界面交互实测、桌面系统窗口实测、发版后自动回帖关单。
summary.en: Equipped with 7 standing shifts: GitHub issue & CI watch, 07:00 daily release, installer smoke check, large-folder stress test, UI interaction check, native window check, and post-release issue replies.

tasks.title: GitHub Issue 与构建报错盯盘
新版本发布后自动回帖关单

大文件夹加载性能测试

description.zh: 一套按「矩阵赛马」运营多账号自媒体的 AI 团队：顶层总控每周比较各频道真实转化，决定加注、冻结或淘汰，并把爆款结构沉淀为共享打法；内置首发样板频道 flagship-channel，自带零 Token 热点哨兵、选题工坊与频道复盘。
description.en: An AI team that runs a multi-account media matrix as a channel race: a top-level HQ compares real conversion each week, decides which channels to scale, freeze, or retire, and distills winning structures into shared playbooks. Ships with a flagship-channel starter product with a zero-token signal sentinel, topic studio, and weekly retros.

zh: matrix-hq：每周日 20:00 汇总各频道增长复盘并给出赛马决策
radar：零 Token 公开源哨兵每小时扫描真实热点与跨网信息差
studio：每日 10:00 产出选题提案，拍板后生成多平台成品包
growth：每周日 19:00 用真实数据复盘频道方向
en: matrix-hq: Weekly Sunday 20:00 channel comparison and race decisions
radar: Zero-token hourly scan of public sources and cross-platform signal gaps
studio: 10:00 daily topic pitches, then multi-platform draft packages
growth: Sunday 19:00 channel retro backed by real data

summary.zh: 首发样板频道：从 Day-0 空态开始，含 radar 热点哨兵（每小时）、studio 每日选题与多平台成品包、growth 周度复盘，用真实数据验证方向是否值得加注。
summary.en: Flagship starter channel: starts from an honest Day-0 empty state with an hourly radar sentinel, daily topic pitches and multi-platform draft packages, plus weekly growth retros to prove whether the direction deserves more investment.
